prose: Athen Chimenti is the man behind Mastering The Zodiac, a website where he provides teaching and tools to help you decipher astrology from the sidereal perspective. In this episode, Athen guides us through some of the key planetary transits and trends of 2020 up to now, revealing how the sky clock reflects our terrestrial events. We also consider how astrology might inform us about the near future. All that and some cryptocurrency talk too!
